page.overview:
Who is Takashi Shirogane?

Takashi Shirogane (銀 貴, Shirogane Takashi), known as Sven Holgersson in the original English dub of Beast King GoLion as Voltron, as well as in an alternate universe in Voltron: Legendary Defender, is a fictional character in the media franchise Voltron, and a member of the Voltron Force.

He has been voiced by Ryūsei Nakao, Michael Bell, Alan Marriott, and Josh Keaton. The character has received a positive critical reception, although his depiction as a gay human clone of the original Shiro in Legendary Defender has been criticised as being poorly written.
